subject: Condemnation of the Racist of Medford Website
overview: The Council heard extensive testimony from residents targeted by an anonymous website and voted to formally denounce the site. The meeting also addressed neighborhood involvement in park design, municipal vaccination reporting, and billboard revenue accounting.

items.title: Condolences and Meeting Dedication
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution offering condolences to the Scarpelli family and dedicated the meeting to the memory of Lillie Scarpelli.

items.title: Public Participation: Anonymous Harassment Website
items.summary: Several residents testified about the professional and personal harm caused by being named on the 'Racist of Medford' website, prompting a debate over the Council's jurisdiction and free speech.

items.title: Resolution to Denounce Website
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution to formally denounce the anonymous website following the public testimony; a second motion to request the removal of a mayoral statement from the city website was not taken up.

items.title: Hearing: National Grid Grant of Location
items.summary: Approved a petition from National Grid to install a conduit for service at 82 Greenleaf Avenue.

items.title: Carr Park Abutters Advisory Committee
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration establish an advisory committee of neighborhood residents to provide input on the Carr Park revitalization design.

items.title: Ceremonial Recognitions and Routine Business
items.summary: Approved resolutions congratulating Frank Mills on his 100th birthday, Jean Cipriani on her 90th birthday, and St. Francis of Assisi on its 100th anniversary.

items.title: Municipal Vaccination Reporting
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to report municipal employee vaccination rates and publish testing requirements and results on the city website.

items.title: Billboard Agreement Accounting
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a detailed report on the expenditure of $250,000 from the billboard agreement and plans for future revenue.

items.title: Small Cell Committee Update
items.summary: Vice President Knight announced the approval of 17 5G facility applications across the city and requested neighborhood notifications for affected streets.

items.title: Committee Reports and Zoning Referral
items.summary: Approved committee reports on precinct changes and referred a zoning recodification proposal to the Community Development Board for recommendation.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved minutes for meetings held on September 21 and 28, while tabling the records for September 25 for one week.
